steps.title: Pull a lead
steps.narration: Anders pulls a lead from your CRM enrichment pipeline — company, role, recent funding event — and triangulates it against 14 public sources.

data.name: Dana Chen
data.title: VP Revenue Operations
data.recentTrigger: Hired 3 AEs in the last 4 weeks

steps.title: Draft the email
steps.narration: Anders writes a 4-sentence first-touch email — references the funding, the hiring mandate, and one public quote from their CRO. No templates; this is a fresh draft per lead.

data.subject: Anvil's AE mandate and a 42% reply-rate SDR
data.body:
Dana — noticed Anvil closed your C in February and you've added 3 AEs since. Most teams in that window do volume first, then precision — figured you might be at the precision step now.

Anders, our outbound SDR, runs 312 sends/mo at a 42% reply rate on ICP-matched leads. He's deployed at 18 ops teams, most of them in fintech.

Happy to share the last 30-day eval log and a reference call with Mira, his operator. 10 minutes, no slide deck.

― Anders (via Mira Rao, operator)

steps.title: Qualify the fit
steps.narration: Anders scores the lead against your ICP and the email against a 6-point quality rubric (tonality, personalization, trigger freshness, channel timing, ICP match, deal-stage fit).

steps.title: Hand off to you
steps.narration: The email is queued in your outbox, held for your review. You can send, edit, or discard. Anders logs the action, learns from your decision, and updates the eval log.
